textSegments: PS2 stand for ATX chassis installation
Complete protections: OCP, OVP, OPP, SCP

Compared to traditional multi rail, single rail 12VO power supplies that adopt the 12V+12Vsb circuit design, the power conversion efficiency can be effectively enhanced. Output voltage stability can be controlled to reduce energy conversion loss, providing players with a smart risk control experience.
I_PSU% provides valuable information on the power supply's performance and utilization, to optimize power delivery for efficient and safe operation.
A New 10-PIN Power Connector to Replace 24-PIN Motherboard

The ATX12VO is a new, smaller plug with 10-pins that replaces the old 24-pin plug on motherboards. It only works with the 12V power type, which helps to make things simpler and reduces the number of cables needed.
The DAGGER PRO 12VO series is compatible with most Mini-ITX and Micro ATX small form factor PCs. It is an ideal for home computer rigs but a great alternative for mini-PC enthusiasts.

The SFX 12VO power supply wire has been reduced from MB 24 pin to MB 10 pin. The original CPU 4+4 is retained, and PCle 8 pin or 6+2 pin is provided for graphics cards. It’s more easier for cable management, repair, assembly, and optimal heat dissipation in the system space.
Fluid-dynamic bearing provides better lifetime and vibration resistance, especially the advantage of lower noise and steadier performance while operating.
DAGGER PRO 12VO series is a power supply with 80 PLUS
Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and as a result to reduce lots of electricity cost.
Premium quality, protecting your equipment from the infamous capacitor leakage problem and also increasing the life-span of your equipment.
Helps users easily install an SFX power supply into an ATX, Micro-ATX or Mini-ITX chassis.
